toni: I'll own manual adjustments and approval routing for enterprise accounts. Will prepare ticket template and legal touchpoints. ETA: same as natalie for triage handoff.
kevin: SQL snippet I used:
```sql
SELECT account_id, invoice_id, SUM(tokens) AS obs, i.expected_tokens
FROM token_events t JOIN invoices i USING (invoice_id)
WHERE t.processed_at > i.period_end + interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY account_id, invoice_id, i.expected_tokens
HAVING ABS(SUM(tokens)-i.expected_tokens) > 5
ORDER BY ABS(SUM(tokens)-i.expected_tokens) DESC
LIMIT 2000;
```
maria: Execution order to avoid duplicative credits: 1) merge dedupe marker, 2) run backfill off-prod, 3) compute diff and freeze auto_flag, 4) run audit-tagged auto-credit job, 5) surface manual tickets for flagged rows.
